stories.title: Trial for self-proclaimed ‘Crypto King’ hears from investors he allegedly bilked

en.title: Trial for self-proclaimed 'Crypto King' hears from investors he allegedly bilked
en.summary: Aiden Pleterski, 27, is on trial facing fraud and money laundering charges, which he denies. Investors are testifying in the case against him.

stories.title: What we know about the U.S. suspect connected to the Tumbler Ridge school shooting

en.title: What we know about the U.S. suspect connected to the Tumbler Ridge school shooting
en.summary: Authorities have identified a U.S. suspect in connection with a school shooting in Tumbler Ridge. The suspect's current residence was located but declined to comment.

stories.title: Ability to fix errors in referendum ballot packages show system works: Alberta premier

en.title: Ability to fix errors in referendum ballot packages show system works: Alberta premier
en.summary: Alberta's premier stated that correcting errors in referendum ballot packages demonstrates the system functions properly. Only 1.2 percent of approximately 250,000 returned packages had issues.

stories.title: Trial hears of two mysterious phone calls the day $22M in gold and cash stolen from Toronto Pearson airport

en.title: Trial hears of two mysterious phone calls the day $22M in gold and cash stolen from Toronto Pearson airport
en.summary: A trial regarding a $22 million gold and cash theft from Toronto Pearson airport examined two unidentified phone calls made on the day of the heist. The calls' connection to the theft remained unclear.

stories.title: Tumbler Ridge killer decorated guns with transgender flag, chose ‘cute’ outfit for mass murder

en.title: Tumbler Ridge killer decorated guns with transgender flag, chose 'cute' outfit for mass murder
en.summary: Jesse Van Rootselaar, responsible for a mass murder in Tumbler Ridge, decorated firearms with a transgender flag and selected clothing for the attack. He had considered livestreaming the violence but had concerns about revealing his voice.

stories.title: Scott Stinson: Ontario calls in the police to investigate its own career-college gravy train

en.title: Scott Stinson: Ontario calls in the police to investigate its own career-college gravy train
en.summary: Ontario is launching a police investigation into its career-college system. Opposition lawmakers are calling for the minister responsible to resign.

stories.title: Public Safety Minister, Tumbler Ridge MP speak on shooting arrest

en.title: Public Safety Minister, Tumbler Ridge MP speak on shooting arrest
en.summary: Canada's Public Safety Minister and a British Columbia MP commented on the arrest of a Washington state resident allegedly connected to a deadly shooting in Tumbler Ridge. Both officials characterized the arrest as significant for the investigation.

stories.title: FBI complaint provides details on Tumbler Ridge shooter’s guns

en.title: FBI complaint provides details on Tumbler Ridge shooter's guns
en.summary: An FBI complaint details the Tumbler Ridge shooter's weapons, including 3D-printed firearm components, magazines, and modification devices for an SKS rifle that were discussed with another individual on Discord.

stories.title: Elections Alberta notifies thousands of referendum voters about invalid mail-in ballot packs

en.title: Elections Alberta notifies thousands of referendum voters about invalid mail-in ballot packs
en.summary: Elections Alberta has been contacting voters whose referendum mail-in ballots were problematic as the agency works to address concerns about election integrity during the referendum campaign.

stories.title: FBI arrest suspect in connection with Tumbler Ridge mass shooting

en.title: FBI arrest suspect in connection with Tumbler Ridge mass shooting
en.summary: A 30-year-old from Washington state has been charged with conspiracy to murder persons in a foreign country related to a February mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C. that killed eight people.

stories.title: Ontario refers private career college OSAP concerns to OPP

en.title: Ontario refers private career college OSAP concerns to OPP
en.summary: Ontario has referred concerns about three private career colleges to police following a provincial audit that identified serious issues with their student aid practices.

en.summary: A 30-year-old person was charged with conspiracy to murder in an attack that resulted in eight deaths.
